QUOTE: The only in-library caller is `mbedtls_memory_buffer_alloc_init` (`library/memory_buffer_alloc.c:566-600`). That is the library's bundled allocator... It sets the allocator pointers to its own `buffer_alloc_calloc`/`buffer_alloc_free`.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer says the buffer allocator's init function is the only in-library caller of the runtime setter and that it installs its own calloc/free over the pointers. It doesn't name the MBEDTLS_MEMORY_BUFFER_ALLOC_C macro, but the substance is there.
